body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal P_4\) and every deterministic triple \(\bar\eta\) satisfying the primitive bands, \[E_P[\psi_a(\bar\eta;O)]-\theta_a=E_P\!\left[\int_0^1S_a(t\mid X)\bar H_a(t,X)\left\{\frac{\pi_a(X)g_a(t,X)}{\bar\pi_a(X)\bar g_a(t,X)}-1\right\}\{\bar\lambda_a(t,X)-\lambda_a(t,X)\}\,dt\right].\] In particular, its absolute value is bounded by a class constant times \(\lVert\bar\lambda_a-\lambda_a\rVert_\infty(\lVert\bar g_a-g_a\rVert_\infty+\lVert\bar\pi_a-\pi_a\rVert_\infty)\).
body.justification: The identity removes the apparent endpoint singularity before bounding the nuisance remainder and exposes the exact orthogonal product drift.
body.gap: Westling et al. (2024), Supplementary Lemma 1 and the proof of Theorem 4, give the survival-curve drift; direct time integration and cancellation of the known quadratic factor are not developed there.
body.consumer: It converts primitive uniform local-polynomial rates into the second-order remainder required by the fixed-endpoint estimator.
